principal + reserve from the owner. The owner is the only authorizer and

the transaction source signs only the envelope. Nothing rests at the
receipt address.

function_v0.doc: Not blocked by the guardian latch or by any controller pause.
function_v0.name: stage_prepare_close

function_v0.doc:
Step 1, ONE owner transaction: burn AVAILABLE units through the vault's
no-reward-claim extraction. The mixture is then held by the vault for the
owner. Not gated by the guardian latch, any controller pause, the oracle
or a deadline. `accept_reward_waiver` is the owner's own choice and is
passed through untouched: without a boundary reading, false reverts
with RewardWaiverRequired (#802), while true waives the unprovable amount.
An available boundary reading is recorded without consuming the waiver.
function_v0.name: stage_emergency_exit

function_v0.doc:
Stage L1b. Permissionless, liquidation-only. Re-proves a blocking cause NOW, then requires the
D3 chain (alive, >= 600 s). Value: the position as if entirely PYUSD (the cheaper asset at or
below the lower band edge) at min(p, P_lo) x (1 - 2%), plus booked idle; no fees, rewards or
pool quote. Lower bound: value(s) - a0*P_lo = L(s - s_lo)(2 - (s + s_lo)/s_hi) >= 0 in range.

event_v0.doc:
Event emitted when tokens are transferred between addresses without a
muxed destination.

Per SEP-41, the event data is a bare `i128` when no muxed address is
involved. The `data_format = "single-value"` attribute ensures the
`amount` field is serialized as a bare value rather than a map.
event_v0.name: Transfer

event_v0.doc:
Event emitted when tokens are transferred to a muxed address.

Per SEP-41, when the destination is a [`MuxedAddress`] the event data
carries both the amount and the muxed identifier so that off-chain
consumers can attribute the transfer to the correct sub-account.

Uses `topics = ["transfer"]` so that both [`Transfer`] and
[`MuxedTransfer`] share the same `"transfer"` event symbol, as required
by SEP-41.
event_v0.name: MuxedTransfer
